Crossfire City · Operation Concrete Protocol · Open-World Zombie Survival

Crossfire City

30 days. One sealed city. One dawn boat out.

Darius Cole, ex-Army Ranger, is trapped inside the quarantine wall around Port Calloway. The Charter gang runs the streets by day; after dark the Bloom-infected run them faster. His brother Milo holds a UV safehouse in the north-east — but a door is not a base, and generators only stay lit if you feed them supplies.

THE PROMISE — Port Calloway is sealed and the Bloom owns the night. In 30 days a boat leaves at dawn — if Milo’s safehouse still stands, if the four engine parts are found, and if you are alive to board. Every day is a run. The Bloom owns the night — you move through it. Survive Port Calloway.

The ARK-grade run: harvest wood, fiber and metal from wrecks, pallets and Bloom growths; manage hunger, thirst, stamina, warmth and carry weight through changing weather; earn XP, spend survivor points, unlock tools, armor, rations and ammo; claim the safehouse, build palisades, spikes, floodlights and a fire pit, then keep it dark and quiet through the nights. Scavenge 6 caches, swap pistol / rifle / scattergun, chain combos — and when the Brute rises, decide whether the payout is worth dying for.

Now with teeth — SCUM × DayZ × Miscreated: a living body simulation tracks blood volume, bleeding, Bloom infection and gut sickness — infected hits seed the Bloom, raw food can turn, and a bleeding man smells like dinner. Loot is DayZ-scarce: thinner caches, longer searches, fewer rounds. The sky has gone Miscreated — dense fog and lightning Bloom storms rot you from the outside in.
